title: Add NoiseTruth dataclass + new tuple return contract for inject_noise
description: Add a frozen NoiseTruth dataclass to etl4/bench/noise.py and change inject_noise from '-> pd.DataFrame' to '-> tuple[pd.DataFrame, NoiseTruth]'. Update every caller so the module still compiles and the existing pytest suite stays green. Blocker for every other T-* task.
expected_output: etl4/bench/noise.py exposing NoiseTruth and new return; etl4/bench/run_experiment.py updated caller
acceptance_criteria: ast.parse of noise.py prints syntax OK
pytest etl4/tests/test_pipeline.py has zero new regressions
All inject_noise call sites unpack the tuple
